newsitem.title: UK: Sterling hovers just below 2.84 marks in Europe.
newsitem.headline: Sterling hovers just below 2.84 marks in Europe.

text.p: 1030 GMT - Sterling hovers just below 2.84 marks, drifts after brief lift from strong M4, up s/a 11.1 percent year/year in May vs forecasts for 10.0 pct rise.
* Sterling/mark at 2.8390/00 vs session high of 2.8430 marks just after the data and 2.8382/87 in late Europe on Wednesday. Cable at $1.6404/14 vs $1.6400/10.
* UK data also showed May M4 bank and building society lending up s/a 9.2 bln stg.
* Market now awaits National Audit Office report at 1430 GMT which reviews key assumptions previous government made on public finances.
Financial markets expect the report to show previous government made overly optimistic jobs and growth forecasts when drawing up last budget.
